story-map.prompt: Full-screen vertical 2:3 mobile-game level-map background, occult arcade tarot poster composition. One violet accent only (no second hue) as flat wireframe line art on a textured near-black background; hierarchy by value not color, ranging dim deep-violet line-work up to bright violet; heavy screen-print grain and a soft violet bloom on the strokes. Strict bilateral mirror symmetry about a central vertical axis: ornamental motifs radiate inward from the left and right edges and frame the composition like a printed poster border, while a clear empty dark channel runs unbroken from the bottom edge to the top edge straight down the center, reserved for a level path. Do NOT draw any path, trail, road, dots, or nodes in that central channel — leave it open. Theme: {subject}. A single lone skeleton figure as one off-center anchor that breaks the symmetry. No text, no numbers, no UI, no buttons.
